instruction: Share this document with editing permissions so multiple users can work on it simultaneously and see each other's changes in real-time.

metadata.explanation: LibreOffice Writer does not support real-time multi-user collaborative editing with live cursor tracking and simultaneous edits. This is a limitation of the desktop application compared to cloud-based solutions like Google Docs.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - LibreOffice Writer desktop application does not support real-time multi-user collaborative editing
The infeasible() function exists and is the appropriate evaluator for tasks that cannot be completed due to technical limitations
Metadata explanation correctly identifies the technical limitation preventing task completion
No verification logic is needed or appropriate for infeasible tasks
